prompt: A project has one view grouped by status as a board, and another view grouped by assignee as a table. How is this possible?
explanation: Views are saved perspectives: same project, same items, different layout, grouping, and filtering. You add as many views as useful — a board for the standup, a table for triage, a roadmap for the long arc.

options.text: Each view keeps its own layout, grouping, and filters — views are alternate lenses on the same items
Each project can only define one view
The team maintains two separate Projects
Boards and tables cannot show the same items
